cards.first_action: Replay the exact ground certificate. Construct the positive square root Q of H_O-theta I from exact spectral data; form the full threshold boundary block and separate its two automatic dark null directions. Test remaining kernel vectors for a nonzero bright ground lead component, distinguishing invisible/core kernels. If regular, prove a uniform small-k expansion and the stated norm/packet bounds; otherwise exhibit an exact scoped counterexample. Stop after two focused assistant effort units, or earlier at proof/counterexample. An unresolved algebraic sign, domain or error bound is inconclusive, never acceptance. No numerical scan alone decides C12.
cards.acceptance: There exist C>0 and k0>0, with k0^2<delta, such that ||T(k)-Q_D||<=C*k and ||R(k)+(I_G-Q_D)||<=C*k for every 0<k<k0. Quantified scope: There exist C>0 and k0>0, with k0^2<delta, such that ||T(k)-Q_D||<=C*k and ||R(k)+(I_G-Q_D)||<=C*k for every 0<k<k0.
cards.falsifier: A nonzero bright transmission/reflection defect in the limit, a different/nonexistent bright limit, or failure of either uniform O(k) bound in this exact fixture. The known dark T=I is not a falsifier of this corrected statement.
cards.deliverable: Uniform analytic proof with exact source binding, exact counterexample, or explicit inconclusive report.
cards.reuse_policy: Preserve the source fixture and all closed/core coordinates. Remove known dark null directions, not actual bright resonances.
